title: Roles are general: admin and user by default
why: The implicit roles came from one kind of app and could deny new signups. Only `admin` is required now; apps with no roles file whose grants name the old roles keep them, with warning B0739.
steps: Run `brain add roles` to declare the roles the app uses, and remove the names it does not use.
Move accounts with `brain backend rename-role --from <role> --to <role>`, then the same command with `--apply`.
